ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Combat Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Adds depth to RimWorld's combat without replacing it.
MELEE - Armed pawns can parry incoming attacks, and a successful parry earns a counter-attack. - Attacks from behind cannot be parried, and a surrounded defender is soon overwhelmed. - Skilled shooters caught in melee sometimes fire point-blank instead of swinging. - Hits land on the side the attack came from, and skilled fighters and shooters can aim for the head, torso or legs.
RANGED - Shooting skill matters more, and the gap between a good shot and a bad one is wider. - Moving targets are harder to hit than standing ones. - Missed shots go wide of the target rather than landing anywhere nearby, and spread further at long range. - Bullets and arrows wound differently - bullets by force, arrows by cutting deep. - Projectiles leave a short glowing trail, so you can see where fire is coming from. - Drafted shooters can pick a fire mode: Precision, Short Burst, Suppression, or Auto by distance. Enemies choose theirs too. - Run and gun: drafted shooters with Fire at Will fire on the move instead of stopping, and so do enemies. - Incoming fire suppresses: pawns under sustained fire aim worse and slower, and pinned pawns hit the dirt and crawl. Bullets flying past count, armor resists weak rounds, and being under fire hurts mood.
ARMOR - Good armor stops weak hits outright instead of turning them into bruises. - Weapon armor penetration is doubled, melee included, so light armor does less than in vanilla and heavy armor does more. A slider in the settings changes this. - Damaged armor protects less: below half its hit points it loses armor, down to half at 0, so sustained fire wears down heavily armored enemies.
EQUIPMENT - Loadouts, set in the Assign tab, choose each colonist's weapons, a backup melee weapon (or one you pick by right-clicking), medicine, and other items to carry. With Progression: Ammunition, colonists carry the refills their gun needs. - Colonists upgrade their primary weapon by skill and switch to their sidearm when an enemy reaches them. - Manually equipped weapons remain locked until you allow automatic upgrades again.
CLOTHING - Gloves and boots protect hands and feet. Masks, helmets and glasses cover the face properly.
Combat and equipment systems can be configured individually in the mod settings.
Not compatible with Auto Arm, Combat Extended, Yayo's Combat, Vanilla Combat Reloaded, Vanilla Fire Modes, Suppression (Continued), Misstall's Combat Tweaks, IMPACT - Combat Overhaul, or Run and Gun. With Simple Sidearms active, Simple Sidearms handles backup weapons and loadouts handle the rest. With another loadout mod, turn Loadouts off in the settings.
